case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear colleagues at Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH,

Thank you for your message.

Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your cost estimates and quality records are noted, though they do not dictate our current pricing.
We accept the increased volume of 23,400 units, the 36-month contract term, and the 56-day lead time.
Based on these extended commitments, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 31.70.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
We meet the agreed quality targets.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear colleagues at Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH,

Thank you for your reply. We understand that market figures are not the whole picture for your company.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 29.30; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.

We are interested in a stable, long-term supply relationship with planning security for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We propose a unit price of EUR 31.50 for the package of 23,400 units over 36 months with a 56-day lead time. This offer consists of a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Furthermore, please provide concrete data to substantiate your statements regarding planning security. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
